sentences.en: The microstructure of weld joint consists of austenitic matrix,[http://sentencedict.com/austenitic.html] columnar crystal in the form of V shape close to the fusion line and fine equiaxed austenite in the centre.

sentences.en: The modified austenitic manganese steel is suited for the operating condition of impact-corrosive wear, chisel-cutting wear and high stress wear.

sentences.en: RA330 is an austenitic heat and corrosion resisting alloy offering an exceptional combination of strength and resistance to carburization, oxidation and thermal shock.

sentences.en: This paper deals with various technics of Austenitic, and meanwhile indicates the principles of their formation.
